notes.title: Update 1.1.9 – Spanish Translation & Major Fixes
notes.notes:
The journey of Saul of Tarsus continues to grow across the world! 🌍

✨ Spanish Translation

The game is now 98% translated into Spanish — including story dialogue, menus, and essential text needed to fully experience the adventure.

Only a handful of minor system messages remain in English due to technical limitations.

🐞 Major Bug Fixes

Several issues discovered during the Portuguese update have now been resolved.

Gameplay is smoother and more stable across all language versions.

💌 Thank You
Your feedback and encouragement continue to shape the future of Saul of Tarsus. Every update brings us one step closer to completing this journey together. Thank you for walking the road with us!

notes.title: 🌍 Language Update – More Portuguese & Spanish Support!
notes.notes:
The Saul of Tarsus Portuguese translation update is here!

🇵🇹 Portuguese Translation:
The game is now ~98% translated into Brazilian Portuguese, covering the full main story, menus, UI, and everything needed to play from start to finish.

🇪🇸 Spanish Translation (Early Access):
The first 15% of the game (intro and early chapters) is now available in Spanish. More Spanish content is on the way in a future update!

🗺️ New Language Menu:
A language selection screen has been added to the game’s intro. You can now choose between English, Portuguese, and Spanish when starting a new game.

Thank you to everyone who has supported the game so far! More updates and improvements are on the horizon.

notes.title: Update 1.1.6
notes.notes:
🕊️ Opening Area Update – Faster Flow, Clearer Visuals, and a Skip Button!

Hey everyone! We’ve just released a fresh update for Saul of Tarsus focused on improving the early-game experience for new players and returning ones alike.
🔄 What’s New:

🎬 Skip Intro Cutscene
 Now you can jump right into gameplay if you're replaying or short on time!

🔔 New Progress Chimes
 Subtle sound effects now confirm when you’ve advanced the story, giving clearer feedback.

🌟 Guiding Stars Added
 We’ve added visual indicators to key locations in the first quest to help new players navigate.

🙋 Streamlined Dialogue Path
 Only 2 campers now need to be spoken to before help arrives (down from 4), keeping the story moving.

🌙 Nighttime Rework + Color Correction
 The campground now feels more atmospheric with a cleaner night-time look — and character portraits are no longer tinted blue during dialogue! This helps the characters stand out and makes the story more emotionally engaging.
